incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — saffron11b TPS spike, increased 5xx and latency across eu-west-1. Alerting at 95th latency SLO breach.

sre_oncall: Acknowledged. Investigating. Initial read: sustained RPM surge from a few tenants + large batch jobs.

raj: Can we do a fast per-model rate trim? saffron11b is dominating GPU slots and pushing queue latency.

alana: Agreed. Recommend immediate per-model RPM cap and temporary TPM decrease to preserve tail latencies. Suggest RPM -> 1200, TPM -> 900 (previously 2500/2000).

maria: Support note: 3 customers show >50% error rise when model is routed to fallback. We'll include them in the customer bridge.

sre_oncall: Applying surgical carveout now. Patch to quota service:
```yaml
# applied by sre_oncall at 1769876600
models:
  saffron11b:
    rpm_cap: 1200
    tpm_cap: 900
    reason: emergency-surge-1769876543
    expires_at: 1769880543  # ~1h
```

sre_oncall: Also toggled funcall off for saffron11b to reduce execution overhead. Command: `redwood feature-toggle disable --model saffron11b --feature funcall`

raj: Routing policy updated to prefer saffron11b-quantized when available, fallback to small-family models otherwise. Need to watch quality regressions.

alana: Notifying infra to add an extra GPU pool for dedicated customers impacted by this. If we can't mitigate within 45m we'll raise the RPM cap back a bit for specific enterprise tenants only.

support-lead: Support bridge standup in 5. I'll post a customer advisory for the 3 affected customers and open tickets.

maria: Quick impact summary for ops: ~6% global request loss for saffron11b, customers on dedicated remain unaffected. Latency 95th improved from 2200ms -> 600ms after caps.

sre_oncall: Logging here: rollback plan ready. If downstream errors spike or latency recovers we will remove the caps. Current runbook step id: SRE-SURG-03.

alanA: (note) I pushed a metric dashboard with a comparison window pinned to this thread: /dashboard/saffron11b/surge-1769876543

raj: handoff to morning oncall @alana in 40m. I'll leave the temporary config with a 1h expiry and a follow-up ticket to evaluate longer-term traffic shaping.

alana: Copy. I'll monitor the bridge and update after handoff. Good job. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-401-saffron-surge, severity: sev-2, assigned: eng-sre, sla-impact: 95th latency breach.
